evidence: As an action, you can either shift your attention
note: Reads thoughts; deeper probe needs Wisdom save; target can end it.

evidence: You teleport yourself from your current location
note: Self-teleport plus one willing ally; collision deals 4d6 force.

evidence: look different until the spell ends
note: Changes appearance for 1 hour; Investigation check against save DC reveals.

evidence: If this damage reduces the target to 0 hit points
note: Dex save for 10d6+40 force; 0 HP disintegrates target; upcast adds 3d6.

evidence: celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls
note: Enemies of listed types get disadvantage vs you; Dismissal can send them home.

evidence: you automatically end the effects of a spell
note: Ends spell of 3rd level or lower automatically; higher ones need ability check.

evidence: The GM offers a truthful reply.
note: Ask GM one question about events within seven days; reliability varies on recasts.

evidence: your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage
note: Your weapon attacks deal extra 1d4 radiant damage for up to a minute.

evidence: effect based on its current hit points
note: Charisma save; HP-based deafen, blind, stun, or instant kill; fey and fiends banished.

evidence: it makes a new wisdom saving throw
note: Wisdom save charms beast; commands it; repeats after each damage instance.

evidence: it makes a new wisdom saving throw
note: Wisdom save charms any creature; commands it; repeats after each damage instance.

evidence: it makes a new wisdom saving throw
note: Wisdom save charms humanoid; commands it; repeats after each damage instance.

evidence: when the target wakes up, it takes 3d6 psychic damage
note: Messages a sleeping target; optional monstrous nightmare: Wisdom save, 3d6 psychic on waking.

evidence: You create a tiny, harmless sensory effect
note: Minor harmless effects: weather prediction, bloom flower, light or snuff candle.

evidence: The ground in the area becomes difficult terrain.
note: Area becomes difficult terrain; Con save breaks concentration; Dex save knocks prone each turn.

evidence: The spell creates more than one beam when you reach higher levels
note: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 force, with extra beams at higher character levels.

evidence: Choose one of the following effects;
note: Touched ally gains advantage on one ability's checks; Bear's Endurance adds temp HP.

evidence: the target also has disadvantage on Strength checks
note: Enlarge or reduce a creature or object; attack damage and Strength checks change.

evidence: must succeed on a strength saving throw or be restrained
note: Str save restrains creatures in 20-foot square; area becomes difficult terrain.

evidence: disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks
note: Wisdom save; failure gives disadvantage on Perception of others.

evidence: you can move in any direction
note: Caster enters Ethereal Plane for 8 hours; returning causes force damage if blocked.

evidence: you can take the Dash action
note: Dash as bonus action each turn for up to ten minutes.

evidence: it can make another wisdom saving throw
note: Wisdom save; sleep, panic, or sicken one creature, retargetable each turn.

evidence: You convert raw materials into products of the same material.
note: Turns raw materials into objects over ten minutes; no creatures or magic items.

evidence: Any attack roll against an affected creature has advantage
note: Dex save outlines creatures; attacks against them have advantage, no invisibility.

evidence: the hound attempts to bite one creature
note: Phantom hound bites a hostile creature each turn for 4d8 piercing.

evidence: you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points
note: Gain 1d4+4 temporary HP for one hour; more with higher slots.

evidence: the creature can make a wisdom saving throw
note: Wisdom save or frightened in 30-foot cone; flee; repeat save out of sight.

evidence: Choose up to five falling creatures within range.
note: Reaction: slows up to five falling creatures to 60 feet per round.

evidence: Intelligence and Charisma scores become 1
note: Int save: 4d6 psychic; on fail Int and Cha become 1 until restored.

evidence: You gain the service of a familiar
note: Summons a familiar with chosen animal form; it can deliver touch spells.

evidence: You summon a spirit that assumes the form
note: Summons a bonded steed mount; casting again restores it to full HP.

evidence: find the shortest, most direct physical route
note: Reveals shortest route to a known fixed location on the same plane.

evidence: This spell merely reveals that a trap is present.
note: Reveals presence and general nature of traps in line of sight.

evidence: A humanoid killed by this spell rises
note: Con save for 7d8+30 necrotic; slain humanoid rises as your zombie.

evidence: Make a ranged spell attack against the target.
note: Ranged spell attack for 1d10 fire, scaling damage dice with character level.

evidence: whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you
note: Choose warm or cold shield: resistance, and melee attackers take 2d8 damage.

evidence: Each creature in the area must make a dexterity saving throw.
note: Dex save; 7d10 fire in up to ten 10-foot cubes, half on success.

evidence: Each creature in a 20-foot-radius sphere
note: Dex save, 8d6 fire in 20-foot radius; half on success.

evidence: You evoke a fiery blade in your free hand
note: Bonus-action blade; melee spell attack for 3d6 fire; sheds light.
